title: mibora minima subsp. littorea
intro: Mibora minima subsp. littorea, commonly known as Sea Carrot, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the protection against cell damage and the reduction of inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Mibora minima subsp. littorea include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its health benefits.
